text:
Samira Kahn: starting Zenith POC perf run. customer target = sustained 320 qps for short replies, occasional 2k+ token contexts. want fp16, ptq-int8, and awq-int8 comparisons + cold-start profile. please confirm infra and corpus.
Nora Patel: we can run in dedicated us-west2. ask for 1k-session corpus with ~10% long contexts. enable prefix caching for warm run. will do warm + cold.
Mateo Gutierrez: recommend 9 active slots + 1 spare for headroom. multi-az doubles infra and needs SLA addendum.
security-bot: security note: customer requested HSM-backed KMS and key-zeroing evidence. we can provide HSM option for Private deployment; adding security appendix.
Nora Patel: test plan: 3m ramp, 20m steady at target, 5m soak, capture p50/p95/p99, kv-cache hit, GPU util. cost calc per 1M tokens included.
ops-bot: provisioning cluster/dedicated/us-west2/slotset-3 image=redwood-runtime:2026-03-28 status=allocating.
Nora Patel: run command (example):
```
loadtest --corpus s3://redwood-poc/zenith/1k.json --target 320 --ramp 3m --steady 20m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant awq-int8 --cache-prefix --output /artifacts/zenith/3970012345/awq.csv
```
Nora Patel: smoke fp16 done: p95=192ms, p99=420ms, kv-hit=71%, GPU util=60%. exporting /artifacts/zenith/3970012345/fp16.csv
Nora Patel: ptq-int8 done -> p95=218ms, p99=540ms, kv-hit=68%, GPU util=46% -> /artifacts/zenith/3970012345/ptq.csv
Nora Patel: awq-int8 done -> p95=176ms, p99=480ms with a few cold spikes to 640ms, kv-hit=75%, GPU util=36% -> /artifacts/zenith/3970012345/awq.csv
Nora Patel: quick cost estimates (prelim): fp16 = $X/1M, ptq-int8 ~0.6x, awq-int8 ~0.5x. will compute exact $/1M in PDF.
Samira Kahn: include 50-case quality eval and flag any >5% accuracy drop. if long-context regressions appear propose canarying to fp16 for >1500 token sessions.
Mateo Gutierrez: ops note for doc: include headroom policy (10%), multi-az cost impact, and SLA addendum trigger.
Samira Kahn: thanks — assemble 1-pg summary + heatmaps + CSVs + cost table + security appendix by EOD. I'll forward to prospect and ask about multi-az requirement. :thumbsup:
